name: kalshi-crypto-books
notes: Structural gates over one `orderbooks` capture of source kalshi-crypto: one book per OPEN market at one capture instant. The bid ladders are lists the rule engine cannot inspect; their shape is the pack's contract (tests drive it). Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-kalshi-crypto-books.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: No open crypto market at capture time is a broken capture, not a quiet one.
One book per market per capture instant.
The six series the source pulls, RESTATED here on purpose: a suite must not read its vocabulary from the source it validates. tests/test_configs.py pins the two lists together.
A value that is neither a known geometry nor empty is a new market type: block. Same vocabulary as the markets suite; empty is allowed here and warned by books-strike-type-set.
A 15-minute market lists before its target price is set, so an open book can carry an empty strike_type ('Target price: TBD'). Warn, not block: the book is real, its strike is unknown until set.
